description.narrative: The proposed Project aims to achieve the following objectives: • Add value to Malaysia’s downstream oil and gas chain is in-line with the Malaysian Government's transformation program to increase the country’s petrochemical output and establish itself as a regional oil storage and trading hub, while creating local employment and moving Malaysia further up the value chain in the petrochemical sector. • Develop Pengerang into a major oil & gas and petrochemical hub for Malaysia. • Contribute directly to Johor’s economic growth by stimulate economic growth through development and employment opportunities, but also through construction of new housing areas and supporting infrastructure. Johor is one of the three states that have a designated petrochemical zone. According to the Johor State Structure Plan 2020, the area in Pengerang has been designated for industrial development. This is reiterated in the Draft Johor State Structure Plan 2030 which states that Pengerang has been earmarked as an upstream oil & gas development cluster for Johor. • Contribute to country’s export growth by generating an annual export turnover of USD 5 billion • Create a sustainable and energy-efficient, state-of-the-art aromatics complex in Southeast Asia to serve the wider Asian market.
